sentence: a ball-and-paddle game in a walled court
title: Paddle Court

brief.rules: Two paddles, one ball. A ball passing a paddle scores for the other side. First to 5 wins.
brief.arena: A flat court 16 m by 9 m with walls on the long sides and open goal lines on the short sides.
brief.ai: The opponent paddle follows the ball with a reaction delay and a speed cap.
brief.controls: paddle_up and paddle_down move the player's paddle along the goal line.
brief.mood: Flat-shaded blocks, two team colours, soft top light.
brief.pitch: Slap a speeding ball past Rival Rex; every tenth hit the ball turns magnetic and sticks to a wall.

aspects.title: Your paddle
aspects.line: Slide along your goal and slap the ball back
aspects.detail: paddle_up and paddle_down move it; every return speeds the ball up by 5 percent, so rallies always end.

alternatives.title: Two paddles
alternatives.line: Steer a front and a back paddle at once

alternatives.title: A spinning bat
alternatives.line: Spin to whack the ball at an angle

aspects.title: Rival Rex
aspects.line: A greedy paddle that lunges at every ball
aspects.detail: TLSteer.intercept_point with an 8-frame reaction; a lunge leaves his far corner open for 20 frames. He grins on a goal and sulks on a miss.

alternatives.title: Twin rivals
alternatives.line: Two small paddles share the far goal

alternatives.title: The wall
alternatives.line: No rival: beat your own best rally

aspects.title: Walled court
aspects.line: Walls bounce the ball, a goal behind each end
aspects.detail: 16 m by 9 m on a kit rink floor for a fast slide; a fixed view of the whole court with your paddle as its subject.

alternatives.title: Ice court
alternatives.line: Everything slides faster on bare ice

alternatives.title: Round court
alternatives.line: A ring with four goals and four rivals

aspects.title: Magnet ball
aspects.line: Every tenth hit the ball sticks, then flies
aspects.detail: On the tenth hit the pack holds the ball on the wall it touches for 60 frames with a hum, then fires it at 14 m/s toward a random goal (ctx.rng).

alternatives.title: Splitting ball
alternatives.line: A hard hit splits the ball in two

alternatives.title: Tilting court
alternatives.line: The court tilts toward whoever leads

note: love it, but the hum should be loud

packages.title: Entry script and rally bot
packages.contract:
The manifest is composed by the Foreman: entry scripts/main.gd, tests [tests/bot_rally.gd], one camera view (hero).
scripts/main.gd: _pack_setup(ctx), _pack_start(), _pack_tick(frame), _pack_state() -> {score: {left: int, right: int}, rally: int}.
Input actions: paddle_up, paddle_down. tests/bot_rally.gd: holds the ball in play for 300 frames.
PLAYER CHECK: tests/bot_rally.gd fails when the player's paddle (driven through paddle_up and paddle_down) never returned the ball.

packages.title: Walled court layout
packages.contract:
data/court.json: {width_m: 16, depth_m: 9, wall_height_m: 1.2, walls: [north, south], goals: [west, east]}.
scripts/court.gd: static func build(ctx, layout: Dictionary) -> void; builds walls under ctx.root from kit parts.

packages.title: Opponent paddle
packages.contract:
data/ai.json: {reaction_frames: 8, max_speed_mps: 6.0, error_m: 0.3}.
scripts/paddle_ai.gd: func decide(ball_y: float, paddle_y: float, tuning: Dictionary) -> float (axis in -1..1).

packages.title: Magnet ball and juice
packages.contract:
data/fx.json: {magnet_every_hits: 10, magnet_hold_frames: 60, release_speed_mps: 14, shake_m: 0.08, shake_frames: 10}.
scripts/fx.gd: func on_hit(hit_count: int, tuning: Dictionary) -> String returns "magnet" on every magnet_every_hits-th hit, else "".
A goal shakes the view (ctx.cameras.shake(shake_m, shake_frames)), bursts goal_flash (TLVfx.burst) and plays score (TLAudio.play).
